card.name: Week and day-of-week schedules
card.fires_on: Spaces, dashes and small words right before a number of days or a weekday in weekly schedules, such as "every" before "7 days" or "once per day," before "Monday". It also fires on week ranges and "Weekly" lists.

modes.label: Every N days
modes.description: The gap after "every" just before a count of days in a dosing interval.
modes.example: 150 mg once a week (every<< >>7 days) for 11 weeks

modes.label: Weekday ranges
modes.description: The point just before a weekday name or a day/date range in a weekly schedule.
modes.example: once per day,<< Monday>> through Friday

modes.label: Weekly cadence wording
modes.description: Dashes or small words in lists of weekly or daily frequencies, or in week totals.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward weekday names and day-count words, and away from month-length words.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a schedule where a number of days or a weekday name is about to come, not months.
